rows.label: Alogliptin after acute coronary syndrome in patients with ty

model.outcome_as_stated: Percentage of Participants With Primary Major Adverse Cardiac Events (MACE)
model.timepoint_as_stated: From randomization until the adjudication cut-off date of May 31 2013 (maximum time on study was 41 months).
model.why: Both posted primary HR analyses lack lower confidence limits; neither provides a complete two-sided 95% CI. No whole-number arm counts, open full text, or meta rows are supplied. Three-point composition and intention-to-treat population cannot be verified.

rows.label: Effect of Sitagliptin on Cardiovascular Outcomes in Type 2 D

model.outcome_as_stated: CV composite endpoint of MACE which includes CV-related death, nonfatal MI, or nonfatal stroke.
model.population_as_stated: Intent to treat population included all randomized participants who received study medication, provided consent, and did not have a major GCP deviation.
model.why: Matches three-point MACE, reported as a secondary endpoint. Timeframe is stated as up to 5 years rather than explicitly trial end. The registry's intent-to-treat population has medication, consent, and GCP restrictions, so it is not unrestricted ITT.
